title: Vis Mundus
description: Simple with vivid colors, if you want to feel in a cartoon-style world!
body:
![Banner for the Resourcepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c080428c91bc59b6745e4c0905a05be5ed975d8c_0.webp)

Welcome to a Resourcepack i have been working on for the **past 10+ Years** (now decided to put it on Modrinth aswell)! In this Pack you will see a more **colorful** experience than Default, with a few _funny Texture-Twists_ here and there, see if you can find some!

Simply put the zip-file into your resourcepacks-folder and you are good to go! If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions, feel free to visit the Discord.
